label: Submerged-arc furnace
description: Electrodes buried in the charge, smelting silicon, ferroalloys or titanium slag.
note: Renamed from electric-arc-furnace_submerged-arc 2026-10-09 (modeller): smelting furnaces named as such beside the steel electric-arc-furnace base.

label: Electrowinning with advanced anodes and energy control
description: Lower-overpotential anodes and current control cutting cell power.

label: Inert anode cell
description: Non-consumable anodes give oxygen instead of CO2 at the anode.

label: Multipolar or chloride cell
description: Cell geometry or chloride chemistry cutting cell voltage and footprint.

label: Prebaked anode cell
description: Centre-worked prebake Hall-Heroult cells with point feeding.

label: Soderberg cell
description: Self-baking anode cells, the older Canadian stock.

label: Prebake anode baking furnace
description: Open or closed ring furnace baking green anodes.

label: Electric anode baking furnace
description: Electric or hydrogen heat replaces the fossil burner on the baking furnace.

label: Homogenizing and reheat furnaces
description: Heat treatment of billets and slabs before extrusion or rolling.
note: Type conventional -> reference 2026-10-22 (node-split review 2026-10-22 (docs/reviews/node-split-review_2026-10-22.csv)): a minor step after casting; melt-cast nodes keep the melting furnaces.

label: Submerged-arc furnace efficiency measures, moderate (off-gas energy recovery)
description: Recovers CO-rich furnace gas as fuel or power.
note: Renamed from heat-recovery-unit_off-gas (Off-gas energy recovery; type efficient variant) 2026-10-22 (node-split review 2026-10-22 (docs/reviews/node-split-review_2026-10-22.csv)): the add-on as a variant of electric-arc-furnace_smelting-submerged-arc.

label: Regenerative or oxy-fuel melting
description: Air preheat or oxygen firing cutting melting fuel per tonne.
examples-named: Regenerative or recuperative burners; Stack melter
note: Merged furnace_regenerative-burners (Regenerative or recuperative burners) 2026-10-02 [C02, docs/reviews/archetype-combination-review_2026-10-02.csv]; it had type efficient variant, trl 9, product-unit t. Absorbed melting-furnace_shaft-preheat (MT05, 2026-10-05).

label: Reverberatory or rotary melting furnace
description: Gas-fired melting of ingot, scrap and returns before casting.

label: Soderberg paste plant
description: Mixes and pastes anode material for self-baking cells.

label: Prebake anodes with bio-pitch and bio-coke
description: Biogenic binder and filler replacing fossil pitch and petroleum coke.
note: Renamed from process-improvement_bio-pitch (Bio-pitch and bio-coke anodes; type prospective) 2026-10-22 (node-split review 2026-10-22 (docs/reviews/node-split-review_2026-10-22.csv)): the add-on as a variant of furnace_anode-baking.

label: Submerged-arc furnace with biocarbon reductant
description: Charcoal or biocoke replaces fossil carbon in the charge.
note: Renamed from process-improvement_biocarbon-reductant (Biocarbon reductant; type alternative) 2026-10-22 (node-split review 2026-10-22 (docs/reviews/node-split-review_2026-10-22.csv)): the add-on as a variant of electric-arc-furnace_smelting-submerged-arc.

label: Pre-reduction of feed
description: Reduces the ore before smelting, cutting furnace electricity per tonne.

label: Continuous casting and rolling
description: Casts and rolls in one line, avoiding a reheating step.
note: Type efficient variant -> reference 2026-10-22 (node-split review 2026-10-22 (docs/reviews/node-split-review_2026-10-22.csv)): a minor step after melting; melt-cast nodes keep the melting furnaces.

label: Smelting efficiency measures, moderate
description: Incremental measures on an existing smelter off-gas and feed system.
examples-named: feed drying with off-gas heat; improved hooding; oxygen control
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column. Renamed from smelting-vessel_efficiency-moderate 2026-10-08 so the name carries its base archetype.

label: Smelting efficiency measures, strong
description: Higher oxygen enrichment with a waste-heat boiler on the off-gas.
examples-named: higher oxygen enrichment; waste-heat boiler on the off-gas; off-gas heat to feed drying
note: Bucket, not a single device: it groups the incremental measures on this technology that the roster files under this variant (design doc s6.2, about 15% energy saving separating moderate from strong). The measures themselves are in the examples column. Renamed from smelting-vessel_efficiency-strong 2026-10-08 so the name carries its base archetype.

label: Flash smelting furnace
description: Oxygen-enriched flash smelting of sulphide concentrate, with a waste-heat boiler.

label: Top-submerged-lance bath smelting
description: Bath smelting with a submerged lance, for concentrates and secondary feed.

label: Direct-fired dryer or curing oven
carriers: natural-gas; electricity; biogas; hydrogen; liquid-biomass; lpg; oil; coal
description: Gas-fired ovens for paint curing, textile finishing and product drying.
note: product-unit GJ: most of its sources price it per GJ (its end use is measured in t product). Absorbed dryer_spray-drum-belt (CH04, 2026-10-05). Absorbed dryer_gas-fired-hood (MN12, 2026-10-05). Product unit GJ -> t 2026-10-09 (product-unit review).

label: Solid-fuel dryer
description: A direct-fired dryer burning coal, coke, biomass or coal tars.
note: Split from the gas- and liquid-fired dryer: UK TIMES costs solid-fuel units at 5-10 times the gas-fired unit. Coal tars are grouped here because UK TIMES costs them as coal. Product unit GJ -> t 2026-10-09 (product-unit review).

label: Direct-fired dryer efficiency measures, strong
carriers: natural-gas; biogas; electricity; hydrogen; liquid-biomass; lpg; oil
description: The direct-fired dryer or curing oven with incremental efficiency measures applied.
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for the UK TIMES advanced drying option. Product unit GJ -> t 2026-10-09 (product-unit review).

label: Solid-fuel dryer efficiency measures, strong
description: The solid-fuel dryer with incremental efficiency measures applied.
note: Added 2026-09-23, split from dryer_direct-fired_efficiency-strong by fuel handling. Product unit GJ -> t 2026-10-09 (product-unit review).

label: Direct-fired dryer efficiency measures, moderate
description: The direct-fired dryer or curing oven with incremental efficiency measures applied.
note: Added 2026-09-23 as the bucket for UKERC or UK TIMES measures on dryer_direct-fired. Absorbed heat-recovery-unit_dryer-exhaust (MN14, 2026-10-05). Product unit GJ -> t 2026-10-09 (product-unit review). Merged press_dewatering (Mechanical dewatering before drying; type efficient variant) 2026-10-22 (node-split review 2026-10-22 (docs/reviews/node-split-review_2026-10-22.csv)).

label: Fuel-fired heat-treatment furnace
description: Batch and continuous furnaces for annealing, normalizing and forging heat.

label: Continuous kiln with heat recovery
description: Continuous drying with zone heat recovery, at lower energy per cubic metre.

label: Dehumidification or heat-pump kiln
description: Heat-pump kiln recovering latent heat from the drying air.

label: Steam or thermal-oil lumber kiln
description: Batch kilns heated by hog-fuel boilers through steam or thermal oil.

label: Cupola furnace
description: Coke cupola or gas-fired furnace melting iron and non-ferrous metal in foundries.
note: product-unit GJ: most of its sources price it per GJ (its end use is measured in t product). product-unit t, not GJ: every example is per tonne of metal melted (corrected 2026-10-02)

label: Induction melting and holding furnace
description: Coreless or channel induction melting, common in modern foundries.
note: Merged induction-heater_melting-holding (Induction melting and holding) 2026-09-23; it had family non-ferrous-metals. Absorbed melting-furnace_electric-resistance (MT06, 2026-10-05).

label: All-electric injection moulding and extrusion
description: Servo-electric machines replacing hydraulic drives, with electric barrel heating.
note: Type efficient variant -> reference 2026-10-22 (node-split review 2026-10-22 (docs/reviews/node-split-review_2026-10-22.csv)): a drive (servo-electric presses), not process heat, and no hydraulic baseline archetype to compete with.

label: Hot press with thermal-oil heater
description: Heated platens curing resin in plywood, OSB and MDF panels.

label: Infrared or ultraviolet curing
description: Radiant or photochemical curing in place of hot-air ovens.

label: Wood pellet mill
description: Dries, grinds and presses sawdust, shavings or chips into fuel pellets.
note: Not the iron-ore pellet-plant archetypes. Drying heat is usually from burning part of the residue. Added 2026-09-23.

label: Biomass torrefaction and pelletising
trl-basis: etsap_2013_010 (pilot and first commercial plants in 2013)
description: Roasts biomass at 250-300 degC without oxygen before pelletising, giving a denser, water-resistant fuel.

label: Steam-heated thermal processing efficiency measures, strong
description: Best-practice steam-heated kettles, retorts, blanchers and vats: heat recovery, insulation, controls and process redesign saving more than about 15% against typical plants.
note: Bucket (design doc s2): DOE state-of-the-art tiers 20-76% below current typical. Added 2026-09-25. Absorbed pasteurizer_regenerative (CH05, 2026-10-05).

label: Polymerization and extrusion efficiency measures, strong
description: Best-practice polymerization trains and extruders saving more than about 15% against typical plants.
note: Bucket: DOE state-of-the-art tiers 21-83% below current typical (HDPE, LDPE, PP, PVC, PET, PC, PS). Added 2026-09-25.

label: Washing and clean-in-place system
description: Product and container washing and clean-in-place systems on site hot water and steam.
note: Conventional host for cleaning-system_efficiency-moderate. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Ethylene oxide and glycol plant
description: Silver-catalysed oxidation of ethylene to ethylene oxide, with hydration to ethylene glycol; separates a nearly pure CO2 stream.
note: The by-product CO2 is concentrated (capture needs only drying and compression). Added 2026-09-25.

label: Anthraquinone hydrogen peroxide plant
description: Hydrogenation and air oxidation of an anthraquinone working solution, with extraction and distillation of hydrogen peroxide.

label: Urea synthesis and finishing
description: Reacts ammonia with CO2 from the ammonia plant to urea, with prilling or granulation.
note: Consumes ammonia-plant process CO2 (about 0.73 t CO2/t urea), which matters to ammonia capture accounting. Serves chemicals.product.urea, added to the snapshot 2026-09-30. Added 2026-09-25. Merged reactor_urea-total-recycle (Total-recycle (non-stripping) urea plant) 2026-10-02 [C27, docs/reviews/archetype-combination-review_2026-10-02.csv]; it had type conventional, trl 9, product-unit t.

label: Biomass gasification to ammonia (whole plant)
description: Gasifies biomass to syngas, shifts and cleans it to hydrogen and synthesises ammonia.
note: Whole-plant alternative to the unit archetypes. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Coal gasification to ammonia (whole plant)
description: Gasifies coal with oxygen, shifts and cleans the syngas and synthesises ammonia.
note: About 36 GJ/t and 3.2 t CO2/t against 28 GJ/t and 1.8 t for steam reforming (IEA 2021). No Canadian stock. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Haber-Bosch synthesis loop with air separation (component)
description: The ammonia synthesis loop and nitrogen supply, priced without the hydrogen plant.
note: A component: combined with the same source's electrolyser into reactor_haber-bosch-electrolytic. Serves no hierarchy node. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Electrolytic-hydrogen direct reduction with EAF (whole plant)
description: Electrolysers, a hydrogen shaft furnace and an electric arc furnace together, per tonne of steel.
note: Whole-route alternative to shaft-furnace_direct-reduction plus electric-arc-furnace; do not combine them in one model. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Calcium sulphoaluminate clinker
description: Clinker based on ye'elimite, fired at about 1250 degC with less limestone.
note: Process CO2 20-50% below Portland clinker. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Hydrothermal calcium hydrosilicate binder
description: Binder made in an autoclave and ground, with no rotary kiln (e.g. Celitement).
note: Rests on one source value. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Oxy-fuel supercritical-CO2 power cycle
description: A natural-gas cycle burning in oxygen with supercritical CO2 as working fluid, delivering CO2 ready for storage (Allam cycle).

label: Ammonia plant efficiency measures, strong
description: Best-practice reforming, synthesis and heat integration in an ammonia plant, saving more than about 15% against typical plants.
note: Bucket: DOE state of the art 46% below current typical. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Steam-reforming ammonia plant efficiency measures, moderate
description: Moderate efficiency measures on the steam-reforming ammonia plant (reformer revamps, heat recovery).
note: added 2026-10-05 (archetype combination review 2026-10-03)

label: Conventional ECF bleach plant
description: Elemental-chlorine-free bleaching sequence with chlorine dioxide stages, without oxygen delignification.
note: Conventional host for reactor_oxygen-delignification. Added 2026-09-25.

label: Integrated bitumen upgrader with capture
description: An integrated bitumen upgrader whose concentrated hydrogen-plant or gasifier CO2 stream is sent to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the concentrated capture service.
examples-named: North West Redwater (Sturgeon); Quest at Scotford
note: Holds host-side facts; the capture plant is capture-unit_* on the ccs.concentrated node. Whole-plant alternative to the unit archetypes. Added 2026-09-25. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant. Type alternative -> reference 2026-10-22 (node-split review 2026-10-22 (docs/reviews/node-split-review_2026-10-22.csv)): as reactor_integrated-upgrader.

label: CO2 pipeline transport
description: Compression and pipeline transport of captured CO2 to a storage or EOR site.
note: Complement to well_co2-storage at the transmission nodes: each tonne needs both; they are not alternatives. Sources price it per tonne (cost-levelized) or per km of pipe. Added 2026-09-25. Product CO2 -> carbon dioxide (naming and end-use split 2026-10-23 (modeller)).

label: CO2 injection and geological storage
description: Injection of CO2 into deep saline formations, depleted fields or oil fields (EOR), with monitoring.
note: Complement to pipeline_co2 at the transmission nodes; not an alternative to it. Added 2026-09-25. Product CO2 -> carbon dioxide (naming and end-use split 2026-10-23 (modeller)).

label: Geothermal heat (direct use)
description: Heat drawn from geothermal wells: hot water from a natural aquifer (direct use) or fluid circulated through stimulated hot rock (enhanced systems).
note: No source costs yet. Added 2026-09-25. Merged geothermal-well_direct-use (Geothermal direct use) 2026-09-30; it had type prospective, trl 8. Renamed from geothermal-well_enhanced (2026-10-05, naming review). Medium tier removed 2026-10-09 (modeller): reported delivery temperatures stay below 150 degC.

label: Steel off-gases to chemicals and fuels
description: Converts blast-furnace and coke-oven gases to methanol, ammonia or other chemicals (e.g. Carbon2Chem), using the carbon instead of emitting it.
examples-named: Gas fermentation of steel off-gases to ethanol
note: A utilisation alternative to capture on the steel mill's concentrated off-gas. Added 2026-09-26. Merged fermenter_steel-offgas (Gas fermentation of steel off-gases to ethanol) 2026-10-02 [C31, docs/reviews/archetype-combination-review_2026-10-02.csv]; it had type alternative, trl 9, product-unit t. Product CO2 -> carbon dioxide (naming and end-use split 2026-10-23 (modeller)).

label: Gas-suspension calciner with post-combustion capture
description: An alumina refinery whose calciner or boiler flue gas is sent to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the diffuse capture service.
note: Holds host-side facts on the alumina node; the capture plant is a capture-unit_* archetype on metal-smelting.service.ccs.diffuse (node added 2026-09-26). Added 2026-09-26. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant. Renamed from digester_bayer_ccs-diffuse (2026-10-05, naming review).

label: Ethylene from lignocellulosic biomass (gasification or pyrolysis)
description: Gasifies lignocellulosic biomass to syngas and converts it to ethylene (via methanol-to-olefins or Fischer-Tropsch); also flash pyrolysis of wood to ethylene and aromatics.
note: Added 2026-09-26. Widened 2026-10-03 to take biomass flash pyrolysis to olefins (proposed NEW reactor_biomass-flash-pyrolysis-olefins, joosten_1998_001, gielen_1996_001).

label: Dry or foam forming
description: Forms paper by dry or foam forming, removing most of the water that the dryer section must evaporate.

label: Deep eutectic solvent pulping
description: Separates lignin from cellulose with deep eutectic solvents at low temperature and pressure instead of kraft cooking.

label: Ring rolling with variable wall thickness
description: Rolls rings with varying wall thickness close to final shape, cutting material and machining.
note: The hierarchy has no non-ferrous rolling node; linked to melting, casting and fabrication. Added 2026-09-26.

label: Prebaked anode cell with CO2 capture
description: An aluminium smelter whose dilute potline off-gas is sent to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the diffuse capture service.
note: Holds host-side facts on the electrolysis node; the capture plant is a capture-unit_* archetype on metal-smelting.service.ccs.diffuse (node added 2026-09-26). Added 2026-09-26. Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant.

label: Hydro- or electrolytic non-ferrous smelting
description: Leaching and electrowinning, or direct electrolysis, in place of fuel-fired pyrometallurgical smelting of non-ferrous ores.
note: IPCC gives up to 99% reduction and an ore-specific cost. Added 2026-09-26.

label: Heat-charged thermal storage
description: Economizers and heat exchangers recovering heat from flue gas or process streams, and sensible or latent stores charged with that heat and discharged to a heat demand.
note: Storage costs are add-on (incremental) costs, pooled only with a base system cost from the same source. Added 2026-09-26. Merged heat-recovery-unit (Waste-heat recovery unit) 2026-09-30; it had type conventional, trl 9. Medium tier removed 2026-10-09 (modeller): reported delivery temperatures stay below 150 degC.

label: Waste-heat recovery unit (economizer or waste-heat boiler)
description: Recovers heat from flue gas or process off-gas in an economizer or waste-heat boiler and supplies it as steam or hot water.
note: added 2026-10-05 (archetype combination review 2026-10-03)

label: Food and beverage evaporators
description: Multiple-effect or mechanical-vapour-recompression evaporators concentrating milk, juice or corn steepwater.
note: Type reference: kept for the numbers, not linked to the CIMS hierarchy, which does not resolve food preparation steps (modeller). Added 2026-09-26.

label: Low-shaft smelting reduction
description: A single low-shaft furnace smelting cold-bonded self-reducing pellets or briquettes with fine coal or biomass and a hot air blast, without coke ovens or sinter.
note: Not two-stage smelting reduction (Corex/Finex has a separate pre-reduction shaft and oxygen-blown melter-gasifier). Added 2026-09-26.

label: Electrochemical cement from calcium silicates
description: Electrolysis at ambient temperature extracts calcium from non-carbonate calcium silicates and makes a cementitious binder without a kiln, so there is no limestone process CO2.
note: No source values yet. Sublime Systems route (MIT spin-out of Ellis et al. 2019); the IEA guide row on electrolytic limestone decarbonation ahead of a kiln is a different route and is not mapped here. Added 2026-09-26.

label: Portland clinker from calcium-silicate rock
description: Dissolves calcium-silicate rock instead of limestone and fires the recovered calcium to ordinary Portland clinker, co-producing a supplementary cementitious material and magnesium; no limestone process CO2.
note: No source values yet. Added 2026-09-26.

label: Combined-cycle gas turbine, power only
description: Gas turbine exhausting to a heat-recovery steam generator and condensing steam turbine; power only (combined-cycle CHP is merged into combustion-turbine_chp).
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Combined-cycle gas turbine with post-combustion capture, power only
trl-basis: iea_2024_001 row 215 (power generation from natural gas, post-combustion chemical absorption)
description: A power-only combined cycle whose HRSG exhaust is sent to capture. Regeneration steam is extracted from the steam cycle, a host-side efficiency penalty that belongs here. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the diffuse capture service.
note: Re-added 2026-10-07 (modeller): the 2026-09-30 merge into boiler_ccs-diffuse predates the power-only combined-cycle archetype (2026-10-01), and design §2 gives every capture-capable host its own capture archetype. Combined-cycle CHP with capture stays on boiler_ccs-diffuse. Exhaust CO2 is about 4%, so capture is the diffuse kind.

label: Sulphite chemical pulping
description: Acid or neutral sulphite cooking with its own liquor recovery chemistry; legacy Canadian sulphite and dissolving-pulp mills.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Beverage spirits distillery, whole plant
description: Whole beverage distillery (mashing, fermentation, pot or column stills, by-product handling), per volume of pure alcohol.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling) Type conventional -> reference 2026-10-22 (node-split review 2026-10-22 (docs/reviews/node-split-review_2026-10-22.csv)): whole plant for one food product; the light-industry demand node is not split by product.

label: Ceramic ware dryer (chamber or tunnel)
description: Chamber or tunnel dryer removing forming water from green ceramic ware with hot air, often kiln exhaust.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling) Absorbed dryer_kiln-waste-heat (MN05, 2026-10-05).

label: Market pulp dryer
description: Airborne or cylinder dryer for market pulp sheets; about a quarter of a kraft mill's heat.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Through-air (TAD) tissue dryer
description: Through-air drying of premium tissue, roughly two to three times the energy of Yankee drying.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Diaphragm chlor-alkali cell
description: Diaphragm cell producing weak caustic that needs steam evaporation; legacy North American stock.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling) Product Cl2 -> chlorine (naming and end-use split 2026-10-23 (modeller)).

label: Copper electrorefining tankhouse
description: Electrolytic refining of fire-refined anodes to cathode copper.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Zinc leaching, purification and electrowinning
description: Leaching of roasted zinc concentrate, solution purification and electrowinning, the hydrometallurgical part of the roast-leach-electrowin route (the roaster and the casthouse are separate CIMS nodes).
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling). Rescaled to the electrowinning cell 2026-10-14 (user, sanity-check NM008, D6): whole roast-leach-electrowin plant energy rows ruled out; SEC is the cell electrolysis figure, 12.41 GJ/t (cusano_2017_001 Table 6.18). Rescoped 2026-10-15 (user) to the CIMS zinc.hydrometallurgy node (leach, purify, electrowin): whole-plant capex rows less the roaster and acid plant (sc-080 to sc-082), electricity 12.41-14.77 GJ/t.

label: Regenerative glass furnace with post-combustion capture
description: A regenerative glass melting furnace whose flue gas is sent to capture. The capture plant, with its cost and energy, is on the diffuse capture service.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling) Description rewritten 2026-10-02: the host plant with its CO2 sent to capture, not the capture plant. Renamed from furnace_glass-regenerative_ccs-diffuse (2026-10-05, glass dropped from the key).

label: Rotary hearth furnace direct reduction
description: Coal-based reduction of composite pellets on a rotating hearth (Fastmet, Inmetco, ITmk3); about 20% above a gas-based shaft.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Thermal or catalytic oxidiser
description: Oxidises VOC-laden vent gas with support fuel; straight, recuperative, regenerative (90-97% heat recovery) or catalytic (300-500 degC).
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling) Merged gas-treatment-unit_regenerative-oxidiser (Regenerative thermal oxidiser) 2026-10-02 [C37, docs/reviews/archetype-combination-review_2026-10-02.csv]; it had type reference, trl 9, product-unit m3. Merged gas-treatment-unit_catalytic-oxidiser (Catalytic oxidiser) 2026-10-02 [C37, docs/reviews/archetype-combination-review_2026-10-02.csv]; it had type reference, trl 9, product-unit m3. PRODUCT UNIT 1000-m3 (a thousand cubic metres; the regulators print it as e3m3; user 2026-10-23).

label: Coal gasification to methanol
description: Coal or lignite gasification and synthesis to methanol: 58-72 GJ/t against 33-37 for gas reforming, about 5 t CO2/t.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Waste-to-energy incineration plant
description: Whole plant: waste reception, grate furnace-boiler, flue-gas cleaning and turbine; per GJ of heat delivered, with electricity and waste treated as secondary products; fossil and biogenic CO2.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling) Product t waste -> GJ heat 2026-10-09 (modeller: a heat-supply archetype is measured in GJ of heat); per-t-waste values converted with cf-wte-heat-per-waste (assumption).

label: Cement kiln with integrated calcium looping
description: Calciner and preheater rebuilt so the kiln concentrates its own CO2 with a CaO sorbent loop; more fuel, power export.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Intermittent ceramic kiln (shuttle or hood)
description: Batch-fired shuttle or hood kiln; roughly twice the energy per t of a tunnel or roller kiln.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Long rotary lime kiln
description: Long rotary kiln burning limestone without a preheater: 6.0-9.2 GJ/t, about 18% above the preheater rotary kiln; legacy stock.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Rotary kiln for expanded clay aggregate
description: Rotary kiln expanding clay pellets into lightweight aggregate at about 1100-1200 degC.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Ceramic tunnel or roller kiln, strong efficiency measures
description: Low-mass kiln cars and fibre insulation, heat recycling between cooling and firing zones; more than 15% saving.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Gas-fired crucible melting furnace
description: Fuel-fired crucible furnace for non-ferrous foundry metal: 2,500-4,000 Btu/lb, about double a reverberatory.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Hot-blast cupola for stone wool
description: Coke-fired shaft melting rock for stone wool, with afterburner; different fuel and emissions from glass furnaces.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Isothermal (immersion) melting furnace
description: Immersed electric heaters with metal circulation; about 26% below electric resistance melting; single installation.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Reverberatory or rotary melting furnace, strong efficiency measures
description: Improved lining, preheat hearth and metal circulation: about 18% saving.
note: added 2026-10-01 from the _high mapping review (modeller ruling)

label: Oxy-fuel rotary iron melting furnace
